hostelRules.title: GNDEC Campus Facilities & Hostel Guidelines
hostelRules.summary: GNDEC provides on-campus residential hostel facilities for both boys (Hostel 1, 2, 5) and girls (Hostel 4). Allotment is merit/distance based during admission. Key guidelines include strictly observed study hours (9:00 PM - 11:00 PM), curfew entry by 8:30 PM (girls hostel) / 10:00 PM (boys hostel), mandatory biometric/register attendance, cooperative mess amenities, strict anti-ragging compliance, and guest room rules.

attendance.rule: Every candidate is required to attend a minimum of 75% of the total lectures delivered in each course (theory, tutorial, practical) to appear in the End Semester Examination (ESE).
attendance.shortageRule: Shortage can only be condoned up to 10% on genuine medical grounds upon submission of verified medical certificates within 7 days of illness.

cgpaScale.passingCriteria: Minimum 40% in ESE (24/60) and 40% aggregate in each subject.
